lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce approves $10.1 million Axon contract for police body cameras, Tasers, AI tools
lead_independence.lead: The Fort Pierce city commission voted unanimously 5-0 on Monday, Sept. 14, to approve a 10-year contract with Axon Enterprise, Inc. worth $10,139,037.87 for body cameras, Tasers, and artificial intelligence technology for the police department. The contract runs for five years with an optional automatic renewal for another five years.
